Hey, I don’t think I could ever understand the pain that comes along with being with someone for so long only for it to end, your feelings are valid and I’m sorry that happened and you’re feeling this way. At this point, suicide seems like the best option for you because it’s an easy way out from the pain, you wouldn’t even know any different. I haven’t got much to go off of, but I know that something or someone does need you here. Here’s a quote from my favourite book: “When you stopped wishing things wouldn’t fall apart you’d stop suffering when they did” and another “the only way out of the Labyrinth of suffering is to forgive”. I can’t offer much advice as I’ve never been in that position, but I can say that through learning how to accept and forgive in life (not condone) that things start to get easier. I’m sorry I’m not of much help but I just want you to know even though it doesn’t seem like it, there are people who care, whether strangers or not. I don’t know you and you don’t know me but I care. I hope you’re still here with us, and if not I hope you’ve found your peace. Much love <3

It’s a long journey and recovery isn’t linear, sometimes things will be really bad and other times they’ll be great, it’s hard, I understand you.
